title: OIDCIdentityProvider
description: OIDCIdentityProvider is the Schema for the oidcidentityproviders API

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: spec defines the desired state of OIDCIdentityProvider

alias.description:
alias is the unique identifier of the identity provider within the realm.
This field is immutable after creation.

authorizationURL.description: authorizationURL is the OIDC authorization endpoint.

backchannelSupported.description:
backchannelSupported indicates whether the external provider supports
backchannel logout.

clientID.description: clientID is the OIDC client identifier registered with the external provider.

clientSecret.description: clientSecret references a secret or inline value holding the OIDC client secret.

secretKeyRef.description: SecretKeyRef selects a key of a Kubernetes Secret.

key.description: Key is the key of the Secret to select from.

name.description: Name is the name of the Secret.

value.description: Value directly specifies the value as a plain string.

defaultScopes.description:
defaultScopes is the space-separated list of scopes requested during
authorization. Defaults to "openid" when omitted.

displayName.description: displayName is the human-friendly name shown in the login form.

enabled.description: enabled controls whether the identity provider is active.

firstBrokerLoginFlowAlias.description:
firstBrokerLoginFlowAlias is the authentication flow used the first
time a user logs in through this identity provider.

hideOnLoginPage.description: hideOnLoginPage hides the identity provider from the realm's login page.

issuer.description: issuer is the expected OIDC issuer identifier.

jwksURL.description: jwksURL is the JSON Web Key Set URL used to validate provider signatures.

linkOnly.description:
linkOnly restricts the identity provider to account linking only,
preventing it from being used for direct authentication.

logoutURL.description: logoutURL is the OIDC end-session (logout) endpoint.

postBrokerLoginFlowAlias.description:
postBrokerLoginFlowAlias is the authentication flow executed after
every login through this identity provider.

realmRef.description: realmRef is a reference to the Realm this identity provider belongs to.

kind.description: Kind specifies the kind of the Realm resource.

name.description: Name specifies the name of the Realm resource.

namespace.description: Namespace specifies the namespace of the Realm resource.

storeToken.description: storeToken enables storing tokens issued by the external provider.

syncMode.description:
syncMode controls when Keycloak imports/synchronizes user data from the
external provider (e.g. "IMPORT", "LEGACY", "FORCE").

tokenURL.description: tokenURL is the OIDC token endpoint.

trustEmail.description:
trustEmail trusts email addresses asserted by the external provider,
skipping Keycloak's own email verification.

userInfoURL.description: userInfoURL is the OIDC user info endpoint.

validateSignature.description:
validateSignature enables signature validation of tokens issued by the
external provider.

status.description: status defines the observed state of OIDCIdentityProvider

conditions.description:
conditions represent the current state of the OIDCIdentityProvider resource.
Each condition has a unique type and reflects the status of a specific aspect of the resource.

Standard condition types include:
- "Available": the resource is fully functional
- "Progressing": the resource is being created or updated
- "Degraded": the resource failed to reach or maintain its desired state

The status of each condition is one of True, False, or Unknown.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

keycloakID.description: keycloakID is the internal UUID assigned by Keycloak for this identity provider.
